text:
Before: a chicken wrap (tortilla, chicken, lettuce, carrot, sauce) cut in half, about 220 g and roughly 400 kcal. A fruit bowl (watermelon, cantaloupe, pineapple, blueberries) of about 150 g and 60 kcal. A bowl of broth-type soup of about 200 g and 40 kcal. Water, which has no energy.

After: the wrap is gone, with only the plastic wrap left. The fruit bowl has just residue. The soup bowl looks nearly empty, with a thin film of liquid left.

Everything was eaten except small residue, so I estimate about 95% of the fruit and soup and all of the wrap.

Mass: 220 + 145 + 190 = 555 g.
Energy: 400 + 58 + 38 = about 496 kcal.
